name: Flaherty's Arden Bowl
address: 1273 West County Road E, Arden Hills, MN 55112

booking.howItWorks: Call 651-633-1777, stop in, or send the online event request form (event type, date, guest count, start and end time, name, email).

packages.name: All You Can Bowl
packages.description: 9 pm to midnight, shoes included. $14.99 Sunday to Thursday, $23.99 Friday and Saturday. Start time may shift for league schedules. Not valid on holidays.

packages.name: Party Packages
packages.description: Party packages from $69.99 to $92.99 per event. Inclusions not listed.

packages.name: Kids Party Packages
packages.description: Kids party packages at $19.99 per person. Kids pricing applies to ages 15 and under.

packages.name: Banquet Room Rental
packages.description: Banquet room rental, $150 to $600. Event spaces include North Hall (seats 50, private bar, A/V) and South Hall (seats 50, patio and fire pit access, A/V available). Onsite catering and private bar available.

packages.name: Banquet Room plus Lounge Area
packages.description: Banquet room plus lounge area, $600 to $1,000. Full Event Space seats 100 with private bar, patio and fire pit.

faq.q: Can we have alcohol at our event?
faq.a: Yes, alcohol is allowed. Private bars and onsite catering are available for events.
Yes, the venue is wheelchair accessible.
Kids pricing applies to ages 15 and under; adults are 16 and over.

faq.q: Is All You Can Bowl valid on holidays?
faq.a: No, All You Can Bowl is not valid on holidays. Start time may shift for league schedules.
Flaherty's Pub & Grill serves food every day from 9 am to 10:15 pm: appetizers, pizzas, burgers, sandwiches, soups and salads.

faq.q: What is the Lucky Strike Lounge?
faq.a: A 1,115 sq ft private space with VR Vive Pro 2 (600+ games), an 85" 4K TV, and an optional bar setup with food and beverages.
A mixed couples tournament on the last Saturday of each month. Check-in 2:30 pm, bowling 4 pm, $30 per couple. Questions: 651-633-1777 or info@flahertysbowl.com.
Fridays at 6:30 pm, coverall prize $1,000. No reservation needed; arrive early.

faq.q: What else is there besides bowling?
faq.a: 25+ arcade games, and a patio with turf, cornhole, a gas fire pit and live music. Leagues and tournaments are also offered.
